text:
Situation: Oxacillin sodium inventory is low at both campuses. Corvale General holds 389.52 units with 25.6 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 48 units with 12.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 55150012715 lists Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) as a registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1286862 of that plant ended 2025-09-05 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI). The label also lists Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) for analysis, manufacture, and pack. Its most recent inspection (1081040) ended 2019-03-01 with a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification. As of 2026-10-21, oxacillin sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list.

Our position: Current supply covers roughly 12 to 26 days depending on site. No FDA shortage listing exists. The OAI finding at Aurobindo is noted but FDA has not linked it to a shortage. We must secure additional supply before stock reaches critical levels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. (plant: ONESOURCE SPECIALTY PHARMA LIMITED - Beta Lactam Division, last inspection VAI 2019-02-14). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited (plant: Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited - Beta Lactam Division, last inspection VAI 2019-02-14). Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation (label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Wockhardt USA LLC (label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending FDA shortage listing; relying solely on current inventory beyond 12 days at Lakeside.
